ValidationRule.description: Only BPAs and System Admin users can move opportunity to closed lost stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), NOT(OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = "Business_Performance_Advisor", $Profile.Name = "System Administrator")),NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Users with BPA role can mark opportunities as Closed Lost
